text:
Sam W.: Quick follow-up on private endpoint renewals when CP is isolated from tenant VPCs. Ran into customer cases where agents couldn't handshake to signer and certificates expired. Need an offline-friendly renew pattern.

Maria L.: Short version please. Is this about no inbound CP connectivity?

Sam W.: Yes. Constraints: CP retains CA in KMS/HSM; many customers want no inbound CP connections. Proposed default: presigned CSR upload + CP pull-sign worker.

Jin K.: Flow idea: onboarding creates single-use presigned upload URL for CSR and a presigned download URL for cert. Agent uploads CSR, CP worker polls tenant artifact prefix, signs in batches, writes cert to download path. Agent polls with jitter/backoff.

Nick P.: Security: no customer-side KMS. CP keeps keys. Presigned URLs should be single-use and short TTL. All signing events must be auditable (signer id, policy version).

Maria L.: Operational: prevent CSR storms with agent-side jitter + token-bucket and CP-side batching (e.g., 200-250 CSRs per loop). UI should surface when agents are using self-signed fallback and alert.

Sam W.: Revocation: lean on short TTL (24h default) + an emergency revocation list for gateways. For high-security customers offer opt-in in-VPC ephemeral signer with attestation (HSM-backed).

Jin K.: Metrics to add: renew_success_rate, fallback_self_signed_pct, csr_queue_depth, signer_latency_p95. I'll spike a signer worker prototype.

Nick P.: +1 but require signer to emit signer_id and policy_id to audit stream. No delegated long-lived credentials in tenant.
